```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Habit;
use App\Models\User;

Route::get('habits', [Habit::class, 'index']);
Route::post('habits', [Habit::class, 'store']);

Route::get('users', [User::class, 'index']);
Route::post('users', [User::class, 'store']);
```

Note: The `App\Models\Habit` and `App\Models\User` classes are assumed to exist in your Laravel application. If they don't, you would need to define them or use the appropriate existing models from your database schema.
